chapters.title: Start the game
chapters.goal: Start a new game and get through the opening.
hints: The title screen needs START or A; the touch screen can also be used for menus.
Choose New Game and let the opening play: it introduces the four orphans.
Name the characters if asked; the names do not matter.

chapters.title: The Altar Cave
chapters.goal: Get through the first dungeon (the Altar Cave) and come back with the wind crystal.
hints: Talk to everyone: people in towns say where to go next.
Battles are menus: Fight, Magic, Item, Run; the D-pad picks and A confirms.
Buy Potions before leaving town; keep the party's HP up and heal at inns.

chapters.title: The wind crystal and jobs
chapters.goal: Receive the jobs from the wind crystal and set the party's jobs.
hints: The crystal gives the first set of jobs; change jobs from the menu.
Job level grows with use: a character gets better at a job the longer they stay in it.

chapters.title: Gear up
chapters.goal: Equip better weapons and armour and keep enough items in the bag.
hints: Weapons and armour are bought in towns; the equip screen shows what is better.
A healer job with Cure makes dungeons much safer.
Save from the menu, and on the world map when the game allows it.

chapters.title: Follow the crystals
chapters.goal: Follow the story through the fire, water and earth crystals, then the dark crystal.
hints: Each crystal is reached through a town and a dungeon: talk in the town first.
The world opens up as the story advances: the ship and later an airship.
Keep levelling the party: the later dungeons punish an under-levelled group.
